Enum Class LogReporter.Section

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<LogReporter.Section>
io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogReporter.Section
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<LogReporter.Section>, Constable
Enclosing interface:
LogReporter
public static enum LogReporter.Section extends Enum<LogReporter.Section>
A section of the report that can be independently turned on or off.

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ALERTS
    Recent entries from LogConfig.alerts(), see LogReporter.Builder.maxAlerts(int).
    COMPONENTS
    The wired component tree: active global properties, then each router's publisher, appenders, outputs, and encoders.
    FACADES
    The distinct set of LoggerAPIs registered via LogConfig.LoggerRegistry.registerLoggerName(LoggerAPI, String), e.g. seeing both SLF4J and JUL means both facades are in active use (not just on the classpath).
    LOGGERS
    Logger names registered via LogConfig.LoggerRegistry.registerLoggerName(LoggerAPI, String), each with its resolved level, see LogReporter.Builder.loggerLevels(boolean).
    METRICS
    Metrics from LogConfig.metrics().
    VERSION
    Rainbow Gum's own version, printed first if included.
